scope: Union of the raw raster inputs used by the main-figure paired calculation; supplementary-only or unused raster variants are not included.

deaa_1214.purpose: Select pixels for baseline LST comparison

daa_1214.purpose: Select pixels for baseline LST comparison

protected_area.input_scale: Positive values converted to 1; preserve source classes

human_footprint.purpose: Restrict paired samples to low human footprint

tree_height.purpose: Vegetation contrasts, temperature associations and pathways

tree_cover.purpose: Vegetation contrasts, temperature associations and pathways

lst_1516.input_scale: Stored MODIS values; converted as x*0.02-273.15

lst_1214.input_scale: Stored MODIS values; converted as x*0.02-273.15

spei.purpose: Paired mean SPEI in pathway tables and SEM
spei.input_scale: Dimensionless study SPEI product; zero excluded

ndvi_resistance.purpose: Resistance contrasts, sample masks and pathways
ndvi_resistance.input_scale: Dimensionless study resistance product; zero excluded

sif_resistance.purpose: Resistance contrasts, sample masks and pathways
sif_resistance.input_scale: Dimensionless study resistance product; zero excluded

evapotranspiration.input_scale: Preserve study-product units; zero excluded; no scale conversion

albedo_2015.purpose: Combined with 2016 albedo for the SEM
albedo_2015.input_scale: Stored values divided by 1000, then averaged over 2015-2016

albedo_2016.purpose: Combined with 2015 albedo for the SEM
albedo_2016.input_scale: Stored values divided by 1000, then averaged over 2015-2016

elephant_density.input_scale: Preserve study-product density scale; no conversion in code

pairing.fallback: highest coverage among eight neighbors; source ordering breaks ties
pairing.spei_output: mean of DEAA and DAA values, matching archived source

optional_display_overlay.description: Optional supplied display mask; no additional raw raster is required for the default background

preparation: Download sources identified in the manuscript Data Availability statement and prepare the exact study products. Grid harmonization alone does not construct exposure masks, temporal summaries or resistance products.
availability_notes: Raw TIFFs are not included in this repository. Obtain public source datasets using the manuscript and its Data Availability statement, then prepare every listed study input. Notebook 00 checks local file availability and optionally grid alignment; it does not download or prepare the study products.
The shared raw calculation loads this complete 19-file main-figure union. Individual figure notebooks do not yet prune it to a smaller per-panel subset.

non_raster_workflows.purpose: Frozen model predictions and observations; nuisance models are not retrained from these TIFFs
Country and patch density observations; not generated from the raster route
